All green: full `TestObservePrompt_` set passes (1.599s — the parallel hang is resolved), gofmt clean on every touched file, `go vet` clean. `recordHotPathSample`/SP20-D6 and the scope/admission path were not touched.

## SP08-D3 implemented (Option A) — concrete handoff

**Production changes (owned files):**
- **`internal/observer/prompt_delivery.go` (NEW):** `WithPromptReplyOnly` marker + `promptReplyOnly`; `opObservePrompt = "observe.prompt"`; `promptReplyOutput` (drain the warning under the session lock, record nothing); `recordPromptDurable` (index record + `linkObservation` + DAG; returns `ErrUnpublished` for a **leased** lost write).
- **`internal/observer/prompt.go`:** `onUserPrompt` split — reply-only → warning only, no record, no turn advance; worker/replay (leased ctx) → `observationRecord`/`adoptTurn` absorb of a redelivery, else PutBytes→record→link→close turn, propagating `ErrUnpublished` when leased. Removed the old fused `recordPrompt`; `pendingThrashLines` labels the warning `st.Turn+1` so the rendered line stays byte-identical to the pre-Option-A post-increment label.
- **`internal/daemon/handlers.go`:** the reply capture is invoked with `observer.WithPromptReplyOnly(rec)` (added the `observer` import). SP20-D6/`recordHotPathSample`/admission untouched.
- **`internal/daemon/daemon.go`:** `runIngested`'s prompt arm now runs the authoritative capture under the leased-identity ctx (kept `scanSentinelForPrompt`, discards the Output → no late injection); a non-durable capture returns non-OK so `ingest.dispatch`/drain leave the frontier un-acked (stays pending). `drainDispatch` no longer increments the loss counter.

No new persisted schema or frozen interface — durable identity reuses the existing sidecar join; `VerbatimPromptID` preserved.

**Tests (focused only; logs in `dist/v6-remediation/prompt-*.log`):** inverted the SP08-D3 evidence test (`…IsNeverCaptured` → `…IsCapturedAtTurnZero`, id-mapping comment kept) + 3 regressions (distinct-same-text, capture-failure-not-acked, replay-emits-no-output); NEW `observer/prompt_delivery_test.go` (6 cases: reply-only/worker/leased-fail/unleased-soft/empty). All pass; the full existing `TestObservePrompt_` machinery set passes.

**Test-only edits OUTSIDE the stated exclusive set (flagged for you; trivially revertible), forced by Option A moving warning/record off the reply path:** `prompt_test.go` — 2 thrash-warning tests re-pointed to the reply-only path; `prompt_record_test.go` — `RealObserverCaptureLands…` drains the ring (worker records), and `RecordingOutlivesTheReplyDeadline` had its obsolete "replay never calls the seam" tail trimmed (that contract is inverted by Option A; "no double" is now pinned via `observationRecord` in the SP08-D3 daemon test).

**Limitations reported honestly (`prompt-replay-work.md` §4):** turn-zero ordering follows worker *processing* order — deterministic for spooled replay, but not proven for a concurrent same-session burst; the code never inspects text to pick an "original", so it cannot silently promote later text. The index↔link crash window is recovered by turn re-derivation + store append-only dedup, so exactly-once holds only up to tested cuts, not in general. Unleased/in-process deliveries are worker-only with no cross-restart identity and no content dedup. `counterPromptReplayedUncaptured` retired to zero (name kept). Prompt durability is async after the WAL ACK, as tools already are; frontier ACK follows capture/ref/link.
